coverageContext: Complete 15-term bladder-cancer research model. Original NR weight metadata is retained; every deposited weight is independently checked against the logarithm of its original OR. Three UK Biobank coordinate labels are annotations, not scoring conditions. This is not the 24-term model containing a GSTM1 deletion proxy. Published covariate-adjusted or smoking-related performance is not the raw genetic sum; no diagnosis, personal probability or screening recommendation is provided.
